# `discarded-resource`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports explicitly discarded successful results from OS calls and recognized
`std.Io.Dir` or `std.fs.Dir` methods that create files or handles.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Discarding the value makes the resource impossible to close and leaks a finite
process-wide handle.

## When it fires

Bind the returned handle and register its cleanup immediately, or use an API
whose ownership is managed by a containing value.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn touch(io: std.Io, dir: std.Io.Dir, path: []const u8) !void {
    _ = io;
    _ = try dir.openFile(path, .{});
}
```
